cards.name: Camp Trillium
cards.description: Day camp for children and grandchildren of Trillium Links and Lake Club members ages 3–10. Activities include golf, tennis, swimming, hiking, whitewater rafting, horseback riding, outdoor games, crafts and lake activities.
cards.review_notes: The undated camp page says five age groups but lists only four: 3–4, 5–6, 7–8 and 9–10. Ages are determined on or before June 15. No age-band session rows could be created because no season dates are published. The site address is the club's published address; the specific camp drop-off location is not identified.
